fix: Slots: the part (tooth of the lamina margin), the place (each side of a sorus, landmark sorus PO:0025359) with its cue, and a frequency ('generally' → usually). As in pattern 14, RDF only: tooth present at_position each_side of sorus. OWL at most 'lamina has part some tooth'.

target: acaulescent: a whole-plant habit quality of having no visible aerial stem, the leaves (here a rosette) arising at or near ground level from a very short or underground stem
fix: Add a FLOPO value under a habit/shape quality for whole plant. Do not use a negated stem: the stem exists but is very short.
